Vasco Eliminates Fluminense to Reach Copa do Brasil Quarter-Finals
In a decisive Copa do Brasil clash, Vasco eliminated Fluminense for the 10th time in the 21st century following a 3-1 victory, according to reports from ge and UOL.
Tactical Breakdown and Match Dynamics
The fixture delivered high-intensity tactical shifts, underscored by a standout performance from Brenner. According to match coverage by UOL and LANCE!, Brenner opened the scoring early, shifting the defensive block of Fluminense and forcing structural adjustments from the touchline.
